_comment: Signed work orders: the authority an agent's action is performed UNDER. Resolved server-side by toolpacks/work_order/bundle.py, never supplied by the agent — a caller names an id, and this file decides what that id authorizes. The whole file is hashed into every decision's audit record, so editing one entry is visible on every proposal in flight. In a real deployment this comes from the CMMS or work-management system, and 'signed' means signed; here it is a file so the product can be installed and exercised in one command.
